import type { ResizeContract } from '@unofficial-krds/contracts';
import { KrdsElement } from '../base.js';
export declare class Resize extends KrdsElement {
    static properties: {
        levels: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
        value: {
            type: StringConstructor;
        };
        defaultValue: {
            type: StringConstructor;
            attribute: string;
        };
        open: {
            type: BooleanConstructor;
        };
        defaultOpen: {
            type: BooleanConstructor;
            attribute: string;
        };
        scaleTargetId: {
            type: StringConstructor;
            attribute: string;
        };
    };
    levels: NonNullable<ResizeContract['levels']>;
    value: string | undefined;
    defaultValue: string | undefined;
    open: boolean | undefined;
    defaultOpen: boolean | undefined;
    scaleTargetId: string;
    private selection;
    private disclosure;
    private scaled;
    private priorSize;
    constructor();
    get committedValue(): string;
    get committedOpen(): boolean;
    private choose;
    private show;
    updated(): void;
    private restore;
    private outside;
    connectedCallback(): void;
    disconnectedCallback(): void;
    private key;
    render(): import("lit").TemplateResult<1>;
}
